text:
maya: heads up — hosted api p99 spiked ~10:42 UTC, affects short completions (<=64 tokens). dashboard shows p99 ~720ms (baseline ~160ms), p95 ~210ms -> 480ms. queue_depth on runtime-router jumped from ~800 -> 2500 for a 3m window.

sam: which shard/route? any recent rollout? :eyes:

maya: multi-tenant surge but concentrated on model-route /v1/generate-small. No customer-specific errors. rate limiting looks normal. saw a kernel-selector rollout around 10:30 (canary->prod).
deploy-bot: rollout: kernel-selector-v2 enabled (canary->prod) at 10:33 by sam.

nate: repro attempt: hitting same route with synthetic short prompts, p99 reproduces on prod nodes. profiler shows low kernel exec time but long scheduling/queue wait. flamegraph snippet:
```
scheduler.poll_wait -> batch_coalesce_wait -> kvcache.lookup (miss) -> io_wait
```
misses in KV cache for prefixes spiked.

ira: looks like kvcache miss_rate for /v1/generate-small jumped from 2% -> 28% at rollout time. eviction_rate also up x3. retention counters show many small-key evictions.

sam: kernel-selector-v2 was supposed to pick int8-opt-v2 for short sequences to save cycles. new path changed priming order and seems to avoid the fast prefilling path that warms KV cache. probable cause: kernel_selector picks optimized kernel but doesn't call kv.prefill for prefix-only requests, causing many misses and increased queue wait.

maya: can we toggle selector to previous heuristic? need a quick mitigation.

sam: yes — toggle feature flag via infractl. command: `infractl feature-set kernel_selector_v2 false --env prod --route /v1/generate-small`

nate: running the flag toggle on canary now. watching metrics.

(2m later)
nate: canary flip done. p99 on canary dropped to ~190ms, queue depth back to ~700. starting staged flip to remaining nodes.

(5m later)
sam: rolled flag across prod. overall p99 back to ~170-220ms. kvcache miss_rate returning to baseline. eviction spikes gone.

maya: thanks. next steps: open postmortem, revert kernel-selector-v2 until fix, add unit test for kvcache-prefill path, and add e2e perf test for short-sequence route.

ira: I'll file issue ENG-RUNTIME-2195, assign to sam + nate, add links to profiler flamegraphs and prometheus ranges.

sam: also adding a rollback watch in deploy pipeline so feature flags affecting batching/kvcache must run perf smoke tests before full rollout.

maya: noted — please include exact deploy IDs and canary node ids in the ticket. I'll send a short customer-facing note to support saying degraded latency briefly due to internal rollout. :thumbsup:

nate: summary: root cause = kernel-selector-v2 heuristic skipped a kv.prefill/priming path for short-seq optimized kernel -> kvcache miss storms -> elevated queue wait -> p95/p99 spike. mitigation = feature-flag rollback. follow-ups = fix prefill logic, add perf gating.

maya: closure: incident mitigated at 10:40 UTC, full rollback done at 10:39 UTC, monitoring normal by 10:45 UTC. creating postmortem draft now.
